notes: RAW datasets are never modified by this preparation procedure.
TUM primary external evaluation preserves the official test partition and filters language=tr only.
Bostancioglu released Turkish XLSX does not contain row-level source-document IDs or published train/validation/test assignments; no new random split is created.
Bostancioglu full released corpus remains primary; exact-deduplicated data are retained only as a sensitivity variant.

duplicate_policy.primary: Preserve released corpus exactly; do not remove exact duplicate rows solely because they are duplicated.
duplicate_policy.sensitivity: Retain first occurrence of identical text_sha256 + binary_label and recompute duplicate metadata.
